text:
anya: hey folks :wave: I'm setting up my dev environment and have a couple q's about hosted vs sandbox keys for day 1. Can I use my hosted key locally and in CI? Worried about leaking tokens and also about flaky 429s in CI tests. Also how do I request a temporary quota bump if we need more RPS for a demo?
mira: welcome! :tada: short answers: don't use your hosted prod key in public repos or untrusted CI. For local dev and wide CI, use the sandbox/dev key or a short-lived service token stored in our secrets manager. Hosted keys are intended for staging/prod traffic and come with stricter quotas/SLA.
devex-bot: docs: https://internal.redwood.devex/keys-and-quotas — includes 'CI & keys' section and the quota request form: https://internal.redwood.devex/requests/keys
devon: to add: sandbox keys have lower concurrency and token-per-minute limits. For streaming-heavy local testing, either run a replay/mock server or request a limited hosted dev key for your team (explain expected concurrency). If you're seeing 429s in unit tests, we usually clamp parallelism and add exponential backoff.
sam: sample curl for local use (put in .env and never commit):
```
export RW_KEY=$REDWOOD_SANDBOX_KEY
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
To request quota increase, email devex@redwood.com with team name, use-case, and target RPS. For CI, create a per-repo service token via SecretsManager and grant least privilege.
anya: thanks — last q: how do I check my current quota programmatically so CI can decide to skip heavy e2e tests if we're near limits?
mira: you can hit the account limits endpoint and read headers. Example response headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset. We also have GET https://api.redwood.ai/v1/account/limits which returns a small JSON payload; if you want I can drop a repo snippet later.
anya: awesome, appreciate it! :smile: I'll try the sandbox setup and open the quota request if needed.
